facts.value: Advanced skills in designing and conducting research applicable to a variety of careers in academia, business, government and non-profit organisations.
A vibrant research environment with faculty who are leaders in their field, focusing on students engaging in translational research.
Four cutting-edge research themes under the umbrella theme of 'Organisation Science & Public Policy'.

The Graduate Research Centre of the Kemmy Business School, established in 1993, ensures that students engaged in postgraduate research have a 'home' and provides necessary services and infrastructure.
More than 100 postgraduate students pursuing Masters and PhD degrees.
Students can apply and register at any stage of the academic year for a research degree, both part-time and full-time, as applications are considered monthly during the academic year.
Many KBS graduates take up senior academic posts, or secure positions with government or private sector organisations.
Research that has impact and consequences for organisational change and public policy.
